def transform(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    rows=[i for i in range(h) if i!=h//2]
    cols=[j for j in range(w) if j!=w//2]
    order_r=sorted([i for i in rows]+[h//2])  # duplicates around: r0,r0,r1,r2,r2
    # build row order: for h=3 -> [0,0,1,2,2]
    def roworder(n):
        o=[]
        for i in range(n):
            if i==n//2: o.append(i)
            else: o += [i,i]
        return o
    ro=roworder(h); co=roworder(w)
    return [[g[i][j] for j in co] for i in ro]
